summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Bridgeman Leads Baycurrent Classic
items.text: Jacob Bridgeman finished at 8-under to lead the Baycurrent Classic, with Jordan Smith one stroke behind at 7-under and three players tied at 6-under.

items.headline: Jon Rahm Exits LIV Golf
items.text: Jon Rahm confirmed he is leaving LIV Golf and will not participate in the proposed LIV 2.0, with his attorney calling the new terms unacceptable.
